```sql
with scoped_orders as (
    select o.order_id
    from orders o
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where not o.is_test
      and s.country_code in ('GB')
      and o.business_date between date '2026-08-31' and date '2026-09-06'
),
attempted_orders as (
    select a.order_id,
           max(case when a.status = 'captured' then 1 else 0 end) as succeeded
    from payment_attempts a
    join scoped_orders so on so.order_id = a.order_id
    where not a.is_test
    group by a.order_id
)
select cast(NULL as varchar) as key,
       cast(sum(succeeded) * 1.0 / count(*) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from attempted_orders
order by value
```
